verdict.rationale: The formulae API docs reference `brew info --json` output, which shows Homebrew's own CLI can emit JSON for at least the core `info` command. The pack shows JSON for only that one command and does not document a JSON schema or broader coverage. missing for 10: evidence of JSON output across other core commands (list, outdated, search, install/upgrade results), first-party documentation of the --json flag and its schema, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent parsing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get machine-readable (JSON) output from core commands so an agent can parse results instead of scraping text

citations.quote: List the `brew info --json` output for all current Homebrew/homebrew-core formulae or Homebrew/homebrew-cask casks.
